about.title: About Us
about.subtitle:
We combine design, quality and professionalism in every stitch,
For uniforms that look good and last long.
about.description:
Fije për Pe is a business founded in Prishtina, started from a passion for sewing and professional design. We create and customize uniforms for businesses that require quality, style and functionality.

Every product is sewn with quality materials, colors that last and modern machinery for perfect finishing. We believe that uniforms are not just clothing; they are part of every business's identity.

delivery.question: How long does order delivery take?
delivery.answer: If products are ready, delivery is made within 24–48 hours. For customized orders, time is adjusted according to requirements.

sizes.question: Do you help with size selection?
sizes.answer: Yes, we guide you for accurate fitting according to staff and work style.

production.question: How long does apron production take?
production.answer: Usually 2–5 working days, depending on quantity and required customizations.

customization.question: Do you offer customized uniforms with logo or name?
customization.answer: Yes, we embroider your logo/name in several positions and colors according to your brand.

design.question: Can the design be chosen by your team?
design.answer: Yes. Our design team helps you with the selection or creation of the design. We propose mockups, adjust colors, materials and logo positions according to your business identity.

remote.question: Can I order remotely, without coming physically?
remote.answer: Yes. We can fulfill all orders online: we communicate about measurements and preferences, send photos/samples when possible, confirm the design and organize payment and delivery by courier.
